r13_contract.comparisonModel: IF chapter_11_1_applicable = true, THEN voyage_plan_present = true and every intended_voyage_hazard shall have voyage_plan_coverage = true.
r13_contract.verificationPolicyBasis: The category policy is based on the source requirement and intrinsic verification method. It is independent of whether any particular LLM model previously succeeded or failed to generate a SHACL shape.

test_cases.rationale: Applicable ship has voyage plan and all represented intended-voyage hazards are covered.
Single represented hazard is covered by voyage plan.
Applicable voyage plan present with no separately represented hazard instances.
Chapter 11-1 not applicable; conditional voyage-plan obligation not triggered.
One represented intended-voyage hazard lacks coverage.
Represented hazards lack voyage-plan coverage values.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
